events.title: Awakened Dreamers: Carnival Spirit at The Jungle Club
events.description: Awakened Dreamers brings their signature alcohol-free conscious dance celebration to their 2026 season home — The Jungle Club Ubud in the Sayan valley. This Carnival Spirit edition invites costumes, creative expression, and community on the dance floor, with DJ sets curated for collective movement and joy. The Jungle Club's jungle-set outdoor space offers a lush new container for a familiar Ubud dance community organiser whose format (alcohol-free floor, intentional DJ curation, community warmth) is unchanged. Dress up, show up, move freely.
events.short_description: Awakened Dreamers' Carnival Spirit edition — alcohol-free costume dance night at The Jungle Club Ubud, Sayan.
